'''2009 Coruscant Regionals Trevin Tyson LS It Is The Future You See (V)''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Trevin Tyson]] at [[2009 Coruscant Regionals]].

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|It Is The Future You See (V) (Virtual Set 12: Martyrs & Magistrates)|OVS12-13-It_Is_The_Future_You_See-remaster.webp|label=It Is The Future You See (V)}}
* '''Deck name:''' Barry made me
* '''Username:''' Tyson
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Original VS17]]
